title: Solubility in Water of Paraffin, Cycloparaffin, Olefin, Acetylene, Cycloolefin, and Aromatic Hydrocarbons
experimental_method: Hydrocarbon-saturated distilled water (gas at 1 atm shaken or stirred over water; liquids stirred or shaken with water) injected (50 microlitre) into a gas chromatograph with hydrogen-flame ionization detection after removal of water on a firebrick/Ascarite fractionator; detector calibrated with weighed liquid hydrocarbon mixtures.
uncertainties_stated: Standard deviation from the mean given for every value (Table I); temperature only held within 25 +- 1.5 C.
quality_remarks: Temperature is room temperature, 25 +- 1.5 C, not thermostatted. Methane, ethane, propane (in scope) agree with Winkler and Claussen/Polglase within about 10 percent. The PDF begins with page 1267 of another article (a discharge/ion paper, unrelated; this paper starts on its journal page 1267 lower half). Temperature scale not stated.

not_extracted_tables: Table II (olefins and diolefins, journal p. 1271): no in-scope gas (ethene, propene, butenes etc. only), image-checked
Table III (acetylenes, p. 1271): no in-scope component
Table IV (cycloparaffins, cycloolefins, aromatics): no in-scope component
